Section Formula, Class 10 board exam: find the point dividing (−1, 7) and (4, −3) in the ratio 2 : 3.

• P = ((mx₂ + nx₁)/(m + n), (my₂ + ny₁)/(m + n))
• x = (8 − 3)/5 = 1
• y = (−6 + 21)/5 = 3, so P = (1, 3)
